visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman sit before a background of grey and white office lockers. The woman, wearing glasses and a brown blazer, holds a large black cushioned "Enter" key gadget while gesturing enthusiastically. The man, in a red-and-white t-shirt and brown cap, listens attentively. A laptop sits on the table in front of them. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused, highlighting their facial expressions and the textured surface of the oversized key. (2) The woman demonstrates the use of the giant Enter key by striking it repeatedly with her fist. She adjusts her glasses and flips her hair, showing an exaggerated expression of stress relief. The camera shifts between medium shots of the duo and close-ups of her fist hitting the soft, cushioned device. Overlays of animated fire and distorted glitch effects appear during the high-intensity striking scenes to emphasize the physical impact. (3) The scene cuts to a screen-sharing view showing a text editor where phrases are typed. A split-screen effect shows a hand hitting the giant Enter key simultaneously with the computer cursor moving to a new line on the screen. The woman then addresses the camera directly, explaining the tactile feel and the potential for palm pain if hit too hard, while the man drinks from a water bottle in the background. (4) The final segment shows the pair rating the product. The man holds up a physical rating card while they discuss price. They guess the cost—300, 150, 135—resulting in a "WINNER" graphic with yellow stars appearing over the woman. They conclude by showing the device plugged into a USB port on the laptop. A final social media overlay with a heart icon and a follow prompt appears at the top.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking at a fast pace with high pitch variability and energetic intonation. An upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM with a steady kick drum beat plays in the background. Short percussive SFX are heard as the giant key is handled. The ambient room tone is minimal, suggesting a studio environment. (2) Each time the woman strikes the giant Enter key, a loud, low-frequency "thud" impact SFX is heard, clearly post-produced for emphasis. A "ding" notification sound occurs during a transition. The male voice enters with a calmer, lower-pitched tone, providing reactive commentary. The BGM remains consistent in volume and energy level throughout this demonstration phase. (3) The acoustic texture shifts during the screen-recording segment. Fast, rhythmic mechanical keyboard typing sounds are prominent. These are followed by the signature heavy "thud" of the giant key. A synthesized "sparkle" or "win" SFX plays when the woman guesses the price correctly. The speech-music overlap is constant, with vocals sitting clearly above the rhythmic BGM. (4) In the closing phase, the two voices engage in a rapid back-and-forth dialogue. The BGM fades slightly to allow for clear enunciated speech. A final "ding" SFX and a brief swell in the BGM energy signal the end of the video. The overall mix is clean with high signal-to-noise ratio and professional-grade vocal clarity.
